name: Kauri Museum
scope: The principal Kauri Museum and its connected wings at 5 Church Road, with the timber entrance and the gallery volume behind it.
era: Extant principal museum building following the 2021–2023 redevelopment

originalReview.notes: Shows the tall gabled entrance, stained cedar shingles, off-white timber columns, white doorframe and terra-red corrugated flank roofs.

review.method: Exact named public-domain entrance photograph plus current operator and project records
review.notes: Reviewed Qualla’s published corpus first. The eligible story photos depict an indoor tractor or an outdoor logging implement, with the exhibit occupying the frame and no reliable view of the museum exterior. The exact named self-release from 2016 shows the entry and adjacent street-side cladding. The existing footprint and the 2023 operator and project records guide the later connected volume.
